item.title: Request for safe, accessible pedestrian gate, 10th October
item.description:
Please could a proper, accessible pedestrian gate be installed here? This vehicle gate has had two metal bars removed to create a makeshift pedestrian opening. The route has been used for years by many people in the local area, but the current opening is unsafe and unsuitable for wheelchair users, pushchairs and people with limited mobility. Given how frequently the route is used, a proper pedestrian gate is needed to provide safe and accessible access.
